summary: Iteration 5 testing: Validated GitHub Releases changelog backend endpoint and frontend platform-aware highlighting + changelog diff view on /tool/palera1n. All 6 new backend tests pass, all 35 regression tests pass, and end-to-end frontend flows (platform picker, recommended badge, localStorage tracking, changelog panel render/expand/dismiss) work as specified.
critical_code_review_comments: Changelog.jsx line 36: when storedTag is older but the user dismisses, the panel does not refetch on next visit because storedTag is bumped to currentTag; this is intentional. OK.

ReleaseTracker.jsx line 164: `finalAssets = visibleAssets.length > 0 ? visibleAssets : ranked` correctly avoids empty list when filter has no matches (e.g., iOS filter on palera1n which has no .ipa). Good UX fallback.

platform.js linux-x86_64 case: regex `/x86_64|x64|amd64/.test(ua)` is checked AFTER the linux test; on Linux UA strings that don't include `x86_64`, falls through to `linux` which still matches scoreAsset linux-x86_64 path. OK.

scoreAsset for `linux-x86_64`: ordering bug — `if (matches(/linux/) && !matches(/arm|aarch/)) return 80;` runs BEFORE the `\.deb` clause, so a `.deb-amd64` not containing `linux` token would score 90 only if matched second; minor since most linux assets contain `linux` substring.
test_credentials: N/A - no auth in this app
seed_data_creation: Used localStorage.setItem('jbhub_last_release_palera1n','v2.0') in browser to trigger changelog panel.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend changelog endpoint: GET /api/tools/{id}/releases/changelog?from_tag=... returns {has_tracker, repo, from_tag, releases:[{tag,name,published_at,html_url,body}], count}. With from_tag=v2.0 returns 6 entries; without from_tag returns up to 5; from_tag==latest returns 0; checkra1n returns has_tracker=false. Frontend: detected platform on headless preview is 'linux-x86_64'; recommended badge appears on palera1n-linux-x86_64. Platform picker has 8 chips. Changelog panel only renders when localStorage 'jbhub_last_release_palera1n' is set AND differs from current tag; dismiss button updates storage to current tag.
